To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) organization development is the major approach to organization change in the world today; (2) it has been around for a long time and is likely to be around for a long while yet; (3) its history is a complex one, with many disjunctures, discontinuities and controversies; (4) the current state of organization development is characterized by a lack of coherence, with a number of different approaches being pursued, and a number of different names being given to it
organization development has been a major influence in the field of organizational change for over 70 years.
the history of organization development has been one of a series of discontinuities and disjunctures that have led to the current state of confusion.

the development of the theory and practice of organization development, and its relationship with wider developments in management and society.

we need to take the long view.
